A prominent [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Unidentified Alderaanian noble (murder)|noble]] had murdered a '''pilot''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The evidence of the noble's cover-up was eventually found in the [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]] of an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Incriminating Evidence}}</ref>
